paper_metadata.title: Exploring the Synergistic Potential of Quantum Annealing and Gate Model Computing for Portfolio Optimization

experiments.description: Level 1 LSSA with MIS: solve portfolio optimization by first constructing a market graph from asset correlations, finding a maximum independent set (MIS) to choose representative assets, then forming correlated sub-systems around those assets and solving the portfolio QUBO on quantum annealing with VQE-based recombination.

algorithm.variant: LSSA with MIS-based sampling for portfolio optimization

hyperparameters.number_of_samples_Ns: limited to a maximum of N/2

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Binary decision vector over assets; portfolio optimization uses one binary variable per asset in the relaxed formulation. MIS is formulated as a QUBO/Ising problem and solved first to select representative assets.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Portfolio: H = -mu^T omega + gamma * omega^T Sigma omega. MIS: H = -sum_{i in V} x_i + 2 * sum_{(i,j) in E} x_i x_j.
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Long-only relaxed formulation; equal budget among selected assets; correlation thresholding used to build market graph; no explicit hard constraints beyond QUBO penalties.
problem_formulation.num_binary_variables: N for portfolio optimization; N for MIS on the market graph
problem_formulation.problem_hamiltonian: Portfolio Hamiltonian H = -mu^T omega + gamma omega^T Sigma omega; MIS Hamiltonian H = -sum_i x_i + 2 sum_(i,j in E) x_i x_j

problem_instance.description: Real-world Indian stock market portfolio optimization on multiple problem sizes, with MIS-based sampling used to select sub-systems.
problem_instance.dataset_name: Indian stock market data from Yahoo Finance

preprocessing: compute expected returns from historical data
threshold correlations at alpha = 0.25 to build market graph

problem_instance.data_preprocessing_details: Used closing prices over the past 5 years; closing prices shown in log scale for visualization; expected returns and covariances computed from the data; correlation matrix thresholded at 0.25.
problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: Compared approximation ratios against classical exact solution for N < 20 and D-Wave Tabu solver for N >= 20; selected best Ns among tested values; results reported across multiple problem sizes.

take sign of weighted sum to obtain final asset selection

experiments.description: Level 2 LSSA with MIS random sampling: first solve the MIS of the market graph using original LSSA-style random sub-sampling, then use the MIS assets to build portfolio sub-systems and solve the portfolio optimization problem with the same hybrid annealing/VQE pipeline.

algorithm.variant: Two-level LSSA with MIS solved by random sampling, then portfolio optimization on MIS-selected sub-systems

hyperparameters.number_of_samples_Ns: limited to a maximum of N/2

problem_formulation.encoding_details: MIS is solved as a QUBO/Ising problem with one binary variable per graph vertex; portfolio optimization then uses one binary variable per asset in each sub-system.
problem_formulation.objective_function: MIS: H = -sum_{i in V} x_i + 2 * sum_{(i,j) in E} x_i x_j. Portfolio: H = -mu^T omega + gamma * omega^T Sigma omega.
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Random sampling for MIS sub-systems; correlation-thresholded market graph; VQE recombination of sub-system ground states; long-only relaxed portfolio formulation.
problem_formulation.num_binary_variables: N for MIS; N for portfolio optimization
problem_formulation.problem_hamiltonian: MIS Hamiltonian H = -sum_i x_i + 2 sum_(i,j in E) x_i x_j; portfolio Hamiltonian H = -mu^T omega + gamma omega^T Sigma omega

problem_instance.description: Same Indian stock market portfolio optimization benchmark, but with the MIS itself decomposed using random sampling before portfolio optimization.

problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: Approximation ratios reported for multiple N and Ng values; best Ns chosen among tested values; compared against classical exact/Tabu baselines.
